newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Montenegro to outline PTT sale plan by year end.
newsitem.headline: Montenegro to outline PTT sale plan by year end.

text.p: Montenegro said on Thursday it would outline a privatisation programme for its postal and telecommunications company by the year's end.
The team commissioned to prepare the programme told Reuters that the privatisation should be accomplished gradually with the state initially maintaining a comfortable majority stake.
"We are preparing a special model which will define the percentage of the state's shares in different stages," said the team-leader Milica Pejanovic-Djurisic.
"The team considers the state should keep a lion's share of the telecommunication system -- even higher than 51 percent in the first phase."
She said the dynamic of privatisation should be determined by law, but argued the state should never give up more than 49 percent of the telecommunications sector.
But prior to any ownership transformation, the PTT system must split in two sectors, post and telecommunications, which she said had already been agreed upon.
